exposure: Reduced fat and sugar maternal dietary intervention during lactation
outcome: Bacterial metabolic pathways (e.g., biosynthesis of vitamins, amino acids, carbohydrates, fatty acids, lipids)
Genes involved in biosynthesis of storage compounds
Genes involved in fatty acid and lipid metabolic pathways
Genes involved in metabolic regulator metabolic pathways
cohort: The study included 10 exclusively breastfed infants (4 female, 6 male) and their healthy mothers aged 22-37.
finding: A short-term maternal dietary intervention during lactation significantly altered the functional potential, but not the bacterial taxonomy, of the breastfed infant gut microbiome, with specific changes in maternal nutrient intake correlating with changes in certain bacterial species or metabolic pathways.
followup_time: The intervention lasted 2 weeks, with observations taken immediately before and after this period during lactation.
